We work with the $2\times2$ Nambu Green's function $\mathbf{G}$ and self-energy $\mathbf{\Sigma}$.
Resumming the Dyson series gives
\begin{equation}
\mathbf{G}(\omega) = \mathbf{G}_0(\omega)\left[1 - \mathbf{\Sigma}(\omega)\mathbf{G}_0(\omega)\right]^{-1} ,
\label{eq:d1}
\end{equation}
which we also write as
\begin{equation}
\mathbf{G}(\omega) = \left[1 - \mathbf{\Sigma}(\omega)\mathbf{G}_0(\omega)\right]^{-1} \mathbf{G}_0(\omega) .
\label{eq:d2}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
